title: Пропись. 1 класс
method: Selected complete pages rendered and visually inspected. No full OCR or extraction of all workbook pages.

observations.content: Pictures, circles/ovals, straight segments, zigzags before letter lessons.
Printed pair and word illustration; elements and lowercase а, аа; uppercase components and А; ending А-а-а!.
Lowercase elements and н; ни/ин, он/оно, она/они; illustration prompts; uppercase Н and names Нонна/Инна; sentence with a picture replacing a word.
Р, names Руслан/Рита; sentences; missing-word prompt; copying; practice of already known capitals.

applicationImplications: Carry over the progression from letter-specific parts to lowercase, combinations/words, capitals and meaningful practice.
Allow a different lesson composition per letter; not every page has the same repeated letter rows.
Treat alphabet reference order separately from teaching order.
Use actual GOST letter parts instead of copying school-cursive primitives and joins.
Do not claim the full 33-letter sequence from this selective inspection.
followUp: Historical selective review preserved. Full order was then verified from headers in propisi-2019-order.json. On 2026-11-03 all 72 complete pages were visually reviewed; see propisi-2019-content.json and output/pdf/propisi-2019-content-reference.pdf.
